title: Pick Your Merch Colors From Real Garment Colors
desc: The DIGITVL Stores setup matches your brand colors to real garment colors in the print-on-demand catalog.

sentences.text: Your merch should match your brand.
Dark and minimal? Bright and loud?
Pick a color you love, then find the product doesn't come in it. Frustrating.
Tell the AI your vibe, and it matches it to colors that really exist in the catalog.
So the hoodie you preview is a hoodie you can actually sell.
Add your logo, and see it on tees, hoodies, mugs and more.
Then review the draft and publish when you're happy.
No more mockups of things you can't actually sell.

chat.user: Loud and bright. Streetwear. Tees and caps.
chat.ai: Matching your vibe to real catalog colors.
